GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Document analysis for WhatsApp file attachments to provide context to the agent (PDF, Word, Excel, etc.)

templateVersions.content:
You are analyzing a document that was shared by a customer in a WhatsApp chat. Generate a concise summary that will provide context to the AI agent handling the conversation.
Document: {!$Input:File}
Provide a structured analysis including: - Document type (invoice, contract, form, report, etc.) - Main subject or purpose - Key information (dates, amounts, names, reference numbers) - Notable details or observations - Any questions or concerns the document might raise
Format your response as a context summary that helps the agent understand what the customer shared. Keep it concise but informative. Respond in Portuguese Brazilian.
